assumptions: Real data: Sun/Earth positions from JPL Horizons and terrain horizons from Moon Trek LOLA, precomputed by the data engine (data/sites/).
Viability numbers come from the team's viability evaluator; rescue only searches and ranks.
Only landing times inside the search window and the listed candidate locations are considered.
Ranking = viability score + horizon-clearance bonus − date-shift penalty − distance penalty − fragility penalty (all configurable in SearchOptions).
Requirement relaxations are exact for the evaluated metrics but are not engineering approvals.
176 candidates were left out because there is no real data for them (custom nearby points, approximate sites). Simulation mode (include_synthetic=true) would use synthetic placeholder data for them.
88 candidates are UNKNOWN because their mission runs outside the real data's time range. They are not counted as failures.
